cards.name: How does UXCam comply with HIPAA, GDPR, and other healthcare privacy regulations?
cards.title: How does UXCam comply with HIPAA, GDPR, and other healthcare privacy regulations?

description.description: UXCam is HIPAA compliant and signs a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) with healthcare customers. It’s also GDPR compliant and signs a DPA. Sensitive fields such as patient names, IDs, chat messages and prescriptions can be masked in the SDK, on the user’s device, so they never leave it. UXCam has a SOC 2 Type II report, is pen tested every year by an independent security firm, and hosts your data in the US, the EU or KSA.

cards.name: How does UXCam help identify friction in healthcare flows?
cards.title: How does UXCam help identify friction in healthcare flows?

description.description: UXCam automatically captures screens, pages, clicks, gestures, and technical events. You can visualize funnels for flows like appointment booking, teleconsult start, payment completion, or KYC consent forms. Session replay and rage tap detection help diagnose usability pain points. Example: a 10% drop-off at insurance verification can be traced to UI confusion or slow load times.

cards.name: How does Tara help healthcare teams understand patient behavior faster?
cards.title: How does Tara help healthcare teams understand patient behavior faster?

description.description: Tara is UXCam’s AI analyst. Instead of reviewing sessions by hand, ask Tara questions like “Why are users dropping off during insurance verification?” She finds the sessions that explain the drop-off and answers with the evidence. Tara works on replays that are already masked and is covered by UXCam’s SOC 2 Type II audit.
